notes: New Studio Desk for beats, chords and vocals, plus Notes & Tasks, Invoice & Quote, Forms, Release and Thumbnail Desks.
A redesigned main menu: Daylight theme, accent colours, Focus switch, foldable sections that become bubbles, and a profile picture with a status.
Switch desks from anywhere with the desk switcher (⇧⌘D / Ctrl+Shift+D).
Phone layouts fixed: no more cut-off top bars, and Studio track names show in full.
